scope: Six whole-month held-out g0–g2 R20 exports; no g3 input. Each model fit excludes its own predicted months and its outer held month.
Jan may be an allowed training month for the July outer design and vice versa; this is explicit and does not make the two windows independent.
Known-airline-only input filter avoids shared missing-carrier groups; original ICAO/IATA parser, UTC takeoff day and strata are fixed.
Only per-outer allowed month label caches may enter the diagnostic; no target clipping or outcome-dependent filtering.
Gap-scaled binary residual pair moments diagnose conditional clustering, not taxi RMSE or final support dependence.
novelty: Independent-flight joint moments plus common source noise and airline/month marginal logit adaptation do not represent fixed-marginal target-peer dependence. Existing classifier context and probability screens are related but not this diagnostic.
required_implementation_checks: Authenticate all six receipts, prediction/model artifacts, historical identity and ordered held IDs; reject outer scope leakage before joining labels.
Preserve whole residual/variance tuples under permutation; group/stratum indices come only from inputs.
Handle insufficient rows/pairs/days and nonpositive denominator as insufficient support.
Report month/day bootstrap conditional on observed strata and fixed estimated permutation null; classifier and finite-permutation-null uncertainty is omitted.
Preserve negative/inconclusive results and fixed gates without stratum or group retuning.
limitations: Coarse strata do not remove unobserved day-varying marginal bias. A positive contrast does not identify causal recorder mode or distinguish all omitted-covariate mechanisms.

Gap is a fixed mode-separation proxy, not the selected tilted support separation. No equality to production marginals is required for this diagnostic, and no covariance estimate transfers automatically.
The two training windows overlap and are reused research data. Both-window agreement is not independent confirmation.
Existing source-noise calibration remains a separate mechanism; a future posterior must preserve exact marginal atom weights and model target-peer conditional changes.
decision: Approve this bounded diagnostic design; await static source and independent synthetic fixtures before root numerical allocation.
